---
title: "Setup Project Infrastructure"
---

<!-- generated-from-action-readme -->
<!-- This page is generated from setup-project-infrastructure/README.md. -->

Bootstraps new multi-repo workspaces by linking the working repository, container build pipeline, package caches, and repository workspace configuration.

The action delegates repository cloning/branch creation plus workspace/Codespaces configuration to `repos`. The template repository is cloned through the same authenticated path, then its complete `.devcontainer/` is copied into the builder. `setupmjr` is used only for the prebuild workflow that it already owns. Interactive README scaffolding is deliberately left out of the unattended action.

Required delegated operations fail closed. Rerunning the action is safe: requested `repos.list` entries are only added when absent, and unchanged repositories are not committed again.

## Usage

```yaml
name: Bootstrap Project Environment

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  bootstrap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: MiguelRodo/actions/setup-project-infrastructure@v3
        with:
          working_repo: "owner/target-compendium@main"
          template_repo: "owner/template-repo@main"
          builder_repo: "owner/devcontainer-builds@target-compendium"
          gh_token: ${{ secrets.PAT_TOKEN }}
```

<!-- action-inputs:start -->
<!-- Generated from setup-project-infrastructure/action.yml by scripts/generate-action-docs.py. Do not edit this block manually. -->
## Inputs

| Input | Description | Required | Default |
| --- | --- | :---: | --- |
| `working_repo` | The primary coding/compendium repository and target branch we are setting up. | Yes | — |
| `template_repo` | The base template source supplying the boilerplate .devcontainer/ layout. | Yes | — |
| `builder_repo` | The repository designated to compile the Docker image and host it on GHCR. | No | `""` |
| `config_repo` | The destination repository where the active workspace devcontainer.json will be written. | No | `""` |
| `renv_pkgs` | Semicolon/comma-separated list of standalone R packages to inject into renv-cache. | No | `""` |
| `renv_repos` | Semicolon/comma-separated list of lockfile repositories to cache via renv-cache. | No | `""` |
| `repos_list` | Semicolon/comma-separated list of external sub-repositories/branches to track. | No | `""` |
| `gh_token` | A Classic PAT (or Fine-Grained PAT) with write access across all involved repositories. | Yes | — |
<!-- action-inputs:end -->

## Outputs

* Working, builder, config, and template repositories are cloned or have requested branches created by `repos`.
* The full template `.devcontainer/`, including dotfiles, is copied into the builder.
* `repos.list`, Codespaces permissions, and `entire-project.code-workspace` are managed by `repos`.
* A separate builder receives `.github/workflows/prebuild-devcontainer.yml` via `setupmjr repo action prebuild-devcontainer`.
* A separate config repository is pointed at the builder GHCR image.
* Job summary details are written to the GitHub Actions UI.
